metadata.title: AI Safety Frameworks and Governance 2025-2030
metadata.scope: Comprehensive analysis of AI safety frameworks, regulations, and governance mechanisms
metadata.sources: Perplexity Pro Search with citations from official documents, policy papers, and news sources

anthropic_rsp.name: Responsible Scaling Policy (RSP)
anthropic_rsp.description: Graduated AI Safety Levels (ASL) that scale safeguards with model capabilities, inspired by biosafety levels

ASL-1.definition: Basic models with minimal risks (e.g., chess bots)

ASL-2.definition: Baseline for current AI deployments with standard risks
ASL-2.security: Protection against opportunistic attackers via vendor reviews and physical measures

security_standard: Protection against non-state actors (hacktivists, cybercrime groups)

ASL-4.requirements: Counter state-level threats with stricter standards
ASL-4.security: Expected to require nation-state level defenses
ASL-4.status: No models classified yet; specifications being developed

CBRN-3.threshold: Model significantly aids basic-technical-background actors (e.g., undergrad STEM) in creating/deploying CBRN weapons

CBRN-4.threshold: Substantially uplifts moderately resourced state programs (e.g., novel designs, acceleration)

AI_RD_4.threshold: Fully automates entry-level remote Anthropic researcher work; checkpoint at >50% success on 2-8 hour software tasks

AI_RD_5.threshold: Causes dramatic scaling acceleration (e.g., recursive self-improvement)

evaluation_process.oversight: CEO and RSO (Responsible Scaling Officer) oversight
evaluation_process.frequency: Before major model releases and at compute thresholds

tracked_categories.name: Biological and Chemical
tracked_categories.description: Risks of accelerating bioweapon development or chemical threats
tracked_categories.high_threshold: Counterfactual aid to novices in creating threats

tracked_categories.name: Cybersecurity
tracked_categories.description: Risks of scaling cyberattacks or enabling novel cyber capabilities

tracked_categories.name: AI Self-improvement
tracked_categories.description: Risks of accelerating AI R&D beyond human control

high_capability.requirements: High-standard safeguards (misuse prevention, security) before external deployment

critical_capability.example: Novel CDC Class A agent creation
critical_capability.requirements: Halts development until Critical safeguards specified; applies during development

evaluation_methods.capabilities_reports: Compile scalable evaluations and deep dives to assess threshold crossings
evaluation_methods.pre_mitigation_scoring: Pre-mitigation risks scored; post-mitigation must drop sufficiently
evaluation_types: Wet lab testing for bio risks

governance.safeguards_reports: Verify mitigation; unmet risks block deployment

deepmind_frontier_safety_framework.name: Frontier Safety Framework (FSF)
deepmind_frontier_safety_framework.description: Structured approach to identify, evaluate, and mitigate severe risks from frontier AI models advancing toward AGI

critical_capability_levels.definition: Capability thresholds where unmitigated models pose heightened risk of severe harm

security_requirements.model_exfiltration_prevention: Industry-leading protections scalable by risk level
security_requirements.safety_case_reviews: Required for external launches and large internal rollouts

evaluation_methods.frequency: Run periodically to detect CCL proximity
evaluation_methods.ongoing_monitoring: Automated instrumental reasoning detection for deceptive alignment

enforcement_timeline.february_2025: General provisions (definitions, AI literacy) and prohibitions on 'unacceptable risk' AI systems apply
august_2025: EU-level governance operational (AI Office, AI Board, scientific panel)
Member States designate national competent authorities
enforcement_timeline.august_2026: Main rules for high-risk AI (Annex III) and transparency obligations (Article 50) apply
enforcement_timeline.august_2027: Rules for high-risk AI in regulated products (medical devices, machinery) fully applicable

all_gpai_providers: Information to downstream deployers for compliance
Training data documentation and copyright compliance

systemic_risk_threshold.notification_requirement: Notify AI Office within two weeks of crossing threshold
systemic_risk_threshold.rebuttal_option: Providers may argue model doesn't pose systemic risk despite threshold
systemic_risk_threshold.commission_designation: Can designate based on high-impact capabilities even below threshold

systemic_risk_obligations: Safety and security model report to AI Office

penalties.gpai_violations: Up to €15 million or 3% of global annual turnover
penalties.misleading_information: Up to €7.5 million or 1% of global turnover
penalties.prohibited_practices: Up to €35 million or 7% of global annual revenue
penalties.sme_provisions: Proportionate fines using lower of fixed amount or percentage

california_sb_1047.title: Safe and Secure Innovation for Frontier Artificial Intelligence Models Act
veto_reasons: Regulated based on model size/cost rather than deployment context
Stringent standards to even basic functions
False sense of security focusing only on large models
Not informed by empirical trajectory analysis

sb_53.title: Transparency in Frontier Artificial Intelligence Act
sb_53.focus: Transparency and reporting obligations (not liability framework)

new_york_raise_act.title: Responsible AI Safety and Education Act
requirements: Safeguards against catastrophic misuse (cyber, bio, critical infrastructure)
Incident and capability reporting to state
Security measures for model weights and training data
Documentation of training practices and safety mitigations
new_york_raise_act.legal_challenges: Expected federal preemption and First Amendment challenges

tiered_thresholds.concept: Graduated oversight based on compute levels
tiered_thresholds.example: US Responsible Advanced AI Act draft - pre-registration for lower compute, permits for higher

requirements: Customer identification programs for IaaS providers
Reporting of foreign transactions for large AI training

alignment_vs_capabilities_racing.tension: Rapid capability advancement may outpace safety research
alignment_advocate_position: Use AI to automate safety research to keep pace
Risk of uncontrollable systems without sufficient restraint
Need deliberate slowdown if alignment lags
capabilities_racing_concern: First-mover advantage incentivizes speed over caution
alignment_vs_capabilities_racing.current_state: Nearly 90% of notable models from industry by 2025

open_source_cons: Potential for cyberattacks and bioweapon assistance

industry_positions.openai_anthropic: Emphasize closed models for safety monitoring
industry_positions.emerging_consensus: Hybrid approaches blending transparency and control

cons: May not keep pace with technology

voluntary_commitments_vs_regulation.research_findings: Game-theoretic models suggest voluntary sanctions can achieve better short-term outcomes, but binding regulation needed for long-term stability
